ctx.x: Well, I'm just trying to think. Just one second. Worked with Earl Hines and Cootie Williams until joining Basie in late '49. When they were with Earl, the recording ban went into effect and there were no records at the time. Time when Bird and Diz were playing with Earl, that was never on wax.
No. Well, you know, Earl Hines made some records. I was in the band when he made some records, too. And these records never came up. When I first joined him band.
Yeah, those are the -- that's the famous session no one ever found.
